name: Law and Disorder
caption: GPW World Tag Team Champions as of the promotion's own first newsletter, having won the title at Genesis.

name: Shadowman and Dagger Lorath
caption: Held the GPW World Tag Team Championship in the early weeks of 2000.

name: XtremeCharisma
caption: Held the GPW World Tag Team Championship twice in 2000, losing it the second time to The Coast to Coast Connection in the promotion's own first unification match at Blazing Glory 2000.
notes: The promotion's own Blazing Glory 2000 broadcast bills a wrestler named Quiller on this team's side of the unification match; a second member is not confirmed by name anywhere, so membership is carried as unknown rather than guessed.

tenures.source: The promotion's own weekly newsletters and its own Blazing Glory 2000 broadcast.

name: Violence and Corruption 2000
caption: Won the GPW World Tag Team Championship at Duel on the Dunes 2000.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Duel on the Dunes 2000 line-up and weekly newsletter.

name: VIP
caption: The GPW's first American Tag Team Champions, at the start of 2000.

identity.note: A same-named tag team is separately held under an unrelated promotion (CWF Pro); no document links the two records.

name: Superior Darkness
caption: Held the GPW American Tag Team Championship in the early months of 2000, losing it to The Coast to Coast Connection on the undercard of Duel on the Dunes 2000.

tenures.source: The promotion's own weekly newsletters and its own Duel on the Dunes 2000 line-up.

name: The Coast to Coast Connection
caption: Won the GPW American Tag Team Championship on the undercard of Duel on the Dunes 2000, then became the first GPW Unified World Tag Team Champions at Blazing Glory 2000.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Duel on the Dunes 2000 line-up and its own Blazing Glory 2000 broadcast.
